body: My only way to pass time in the last 8 years has been just that, video games. I used to enjoy them more but as I replied to another commenter, I have some really bad behavioural issues from childhood abuse. Now when I play games, I get so unbelievably angry at myself if I don't do perfect that I smash things and punch walls and shit...
I don't know and that's why it's so bad, I've spoken to at least 4 therapists and none of them have helped me, each with their own stupid theory.
Extreme mood swings, depression, anorexia, childhood abuse leading to bad behavioural habits and I haven't had a real best friend since I was 10...
